name: Universal Logistics - Clearfield Terminal - Clearfield UT

fieldNotes.location: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE LOCATION. Resolved to 120 E 700 S, Clearfield, UT 84015 — the Specialized Rail Service, Inc. (SRS) facility. SRS is a Clearfield-based intermodal drayage / transload / warehousing operator acquired by Universal Logistics Holdings in October 2018 ($12.3M); it is the ULH operating presence behind the 10-K-named 'Clearfield UT owned terminal property'. Address is firm: confirmed identically by FMCSA SAFER (USDOT 506498), loadmatch.com, Yelp, D&B, and Loc8NearMe. However, 120 E 700 S sits inside a dense multi-tenant industrial district and NO SRS signage was visible in any Street View; the exact parcel is address-interpolated. Resolved to the rail-served warehouse/transload building at ~41.1054,-112.0232 because (a) it is directly served by a Union Pacific rail line/spur — the defining feature of a 'Specialized Rail Service' transload facility, (b) it sits on the 700 South surface street where the address interpolates, and (c) SRS's stated business is rail transload + cross-dock + warehouse distribution. The exact parcel within this district could not be positively confirmed.
fieldNotes.truckGate: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE. Street View (2022-11) of the building frontage and yard shows internal industrial-park roads with employee parking and decorative block walls; no barrier arm or sliding/swing gate was observed across a truck lane. Classified false (open, uncontrolled industrial-park access), but the exact entrance could not be definitively walked.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible in satellite or Street View. Classified false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No identified truck gate, so no remote check-in implied; false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banded 10-25. The rail-served warehouse building shows a dock apron with trailers backed along its SW face in satellite; estimated ~14 doors. Low confidence — partly tree-obscured.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Banded 10-25. A truck/trailer yard with parked trailers and chassis lies NW of the building; transload material is staged along the rail side. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropYard: true — a dedicated trailer/chassis yard adjoins the building; low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: true — a Union Pacific rail line runs directly alongside the NE face of the building, with covered hopper railcars parked on the spur and lumber/material being transloaded. Consistent with SRS's rail-transload / intermodal-facility-management business. This is the highest-confidence physical finding for the site.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One long warehouse/transload building running NW-SE alongside the rail. Adjacent parcels (a petroleum/chemical tank farm to the SW) are separate tenants and excluded.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~9.2 acres computed for the building + immediate yard parcel — low confidence given the parcel-boundary ambiguity in this multi-tenant district. SRS operates ~140 tractors regionally; the Clearfield footprint audited here covers the rail-served building and its adjoining truck yard only.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Clearfield is a small Davis County city north of Salt Lake City; the facility sits in a small-town industrial district. Per the rubric's small-town-industrial guidance, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~90 — honest estimate for the adjoining truck yard, low confidence.
